title: How can I move my Business Central-related Azure resources to a new Azure region?
summary: Guide for migrating Business Central-related Azure and Power Platform resources from West Europe or North Europe to the new Italy North region. Covers strategic reasons for migration, detailed step-by-step procedures for Azure services (Application Insights, Storage, Function Apps, Logic Apps, SQL Database, Azure OpenAI) and Power Platform environments, migration strategies to minimize downtime, cost considerations, and post-migration reconfiguration tasks.
key_points: Moving Azure services to Italy North is optional; average latency is about 22 ms from Italy North to West Europe, so most services are barely affected.

Most Azure resources (Application Insights, Storage, Function Apps, Logic Apps, Azure OpenAI) are recreated in the new region and their data and settings copied over; Azure SQL can also use Resource Mover.
Power Platform geo-to-geo migration requires a Microsoft Support request at least 10 days ahead, involves downtime and cannot run in parallel with the old environment.
Canvas apps and flows outside solutions, enterprise policies, DLP rules and environment groups do not migrate and must be recreated.
Business Central needs updated connection strings and endpoints afterward, such as the telemetry connection string and the Power Platform environment references.
features: Azure Resource Mover for SQL Database
